subject: [PATCH v3 06/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Stop polling devices when the unresponding scan is cancelled

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch addresses a problem where the MPT3SAS_REMOVE_UNRESPONDING_DEVICES event consumes all retries of devices it polls, marking them as deleted and offline without actually testing them. The issue occurs when a hard reset or host removal starts during polling, causing the readiness check to not test devices. To fix this, the patch adds a check to stop polling if the event is being cancelled or the host is being removed. This prevents unnecessary retries and ensures that devices are properly tested before being marked as deleted.
